_comment: P3-04 report/enforce switch. 'enforce' = a failing gate fails the test/job; 'report' = the failure is printed and written to the report file but the job stays green. Env overrides for a one-off run: THEME_CONFORMANCE_KIT, THEME_CONFORMANCE_PREMIUM (report|enforce). Owner Q7 (2026-10-05): budgets block for the 5 kit themes, report-only for premium. P3-05 (first kit theme in Blade, `table`) flipped kit_mode to enforce; P3-07 ported `brew` and took it off the list; P3-08 ported `aisle` and P3-09 `basket`, and did the same. A kit theme listed in report_until_ported has no Blade views yet (only the design prototypes, whose preview script is not theme code): it stays report-only until its own work item ports it and removes it from that list. rtl.<theme>.limit is the share of pixels that may differ from the prototype; rtl.<theme>.exempt names the screens that cannot match it and why.

exempt.states: the prototype board also shows the hosted-payment states (API-2/API-10), which are not product features yet
exempt.kiosk: the prototype kiosk screen is a short showcase with the design's sample content; the product's kiosk lists every category of the store (P3-06). Structure, order and tokens are checked by the static, axe, keyboard and CSP gates on the same page
exempt.kiosk-states: the same board for the kiosk screens: 20 px off the prototype's height from the product's wording (P3-06)
